name: bounded_sql_query
detail: SELECT TO_CHAR(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM generate_series( DATE '2022-01-01', DATE '2022-12-01', INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS m(month_start) LEFT JOIN pagila.public.rental r ON r.rental_date >= m.month_start AND r.rental_date < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY m.month_start ORDER BY m.month_start;

sql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
FROM generate_series(
  DATE '2022-01-01',
  DATE '2022-12-01',
  INTERVAL '1 month'
) AS m(month_start)
LEFT JOIN pagila.public.rental r
  ON r.rental_date >= m.month_start
  AND r.rental_date < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start;
